findings.message: The client-supplied `client_name` is interpolated into a shell command run with `shell=True`. A name such as `x; rm -rf ~` executes arbitrary commands on the server.
findings.suggestion: subprocess.run(["convert", str(UPLOAD_DIR / client_name), "-resize", "128x128", str(UPLOAD_DIR / target)], check=True)

findings.message: `client_name` is never checked to be a plain file name, so values with `..` or `/` read files outside `UPLOAD_DIR`. The derived `thumb-` target can also be written outside it. Reject names that are not a bare file name, or resolve both paths and confirm they stay inside `UPLOAD_DIR`.
This adds new thumbnail-generation behaviour but no test comes with it.
